test_title: PYST 45: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only five people sit to the right of A. Only five people sit to the left of B. F is the immediate neighbour of G and E. C sits second to the left of E. How many people sit to the left of G?
solution:
**Given: **Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a row, facing north.

1. Only five people sit to the right of A.

2. Only five people sit to the left of B.

3. F is the immediate neighbour of G and E.

4. C sits second to the left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee6913c401cb7be000bbc4bb4a188d97c5f15a06c232c3c8a735df971fb20a65.png] 

 

D, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b6fc9a6eae9ebbe1ae1509a6d61c4687240f900301f2d46a37b97cb88b6ca92.png] 

 

Thus, four people sit to the left of G.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
